data.title: NMIMS vs Symbiosis Distance MBA: Which One to Choose?
data.excerpt: Finalizing an institution for higher education has always been difficult for students and working professionals. Similarly, students willing to pursue a distance MBA have multiple choices of top universities, yet they are stuck in choosing between the Symbiosis and NMIMS distance MBA programs.
data.meta_description: Compare NMIMS and Symbiosis distance MBA programs by fees, recognition, curriculum, flexibility and student support to choose the right option for you.
data.content_html:
Finalizing an institution for higher education has always been difficult for students and working professionals. Similarly, students willing to pursue a distance MBA have multiple choices of top universities, yet they are stuck in choosing between the Symbiosis and NMIMS distance MBA programs.

To know in detail about the Symbiosis vs NMIMS distance BA programs, read this blog till the end.

Program Overview

Both the MBAs are offered through an online and distance learning mode, allowing students to maintain a work-life balance and acquire a postgraduate degree while working full-time and managing other responsibilities. A brief breakdown of NMIMS vs Symbiosis distance MBA programs is explained below.

NMIMS Distance MBA

The NMIMS distance MBA programs are offered under its Centre for Distance and Online Education (CDOE) department. It is a 2-year degree program delivered through a 100% online learning mode, which makes students industry-ready with its robust curriculum.

Key highlights of NMIMS distance MBA programs:

  • Duration: 2 years (4 years of validity)
  • Fees: INR 55,000 /- per semester
  • Specializations: Marketing Management, Business Management, Financial Management, Human Resource Management, and Operations and Data Sciences Management.

Symbiosis Distance MBA

Symbiosis offers Post Graduate Diploma programs that are equivalent to an MBA degree program and hold similar value and credibility. The Symbiosis distance MBA is offered under the Symbiosis Centre fr Distance Learning (SCDL). These courses are designed to develop leadership skills and assist students in acquiring comprehensive business knowledge.

Key highlights of the Symbiosis distance MBA program are as follows:

  • Duration: 2 years (registration validity 4 years)
  • Fees: INR 74,000 /-
  • Specializations: Business Administration, Retail Management, Information Technology, Export & Import Management, etc.

Eligibility and Admission Process

The eligibility criteria for NMIMS vs Symbiosis distance NBA programs are as follows:

NMIMS Distance MBA EligibilitySymbiosis Distance MBA Eligibility
A valid bachelor’s degree recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). A minimum of 50% of aggregate marks at graduation.A valid undergraduate degree from a recognized institution.

Fees Comparison

The fee structure of both courses is different and has a slight difference in the complete course amount, as listed below:

  • NMIMS distance MBA fee:

Students can pay the NMIMS distance MBA fee as follows:

Fee PlanFee AmountFee Amount
Semester PlanINR 55,000 /- (4 semester)INR 2,20,000 /-
Annual PlanINR 1,05,000 /- (2 years)INR 2,10,000 /-
One-time payment planINR 1,96,000 /-INR 1,96,000 /-
  • Symbiosis distance MBA fee:

The entire 2-year distance MBA course at Symbiosis costs INR 74,000 /- which can be paid in 2 installments:

  • Installment- INR 44,000 /-
  • Installment- INR 34,000 /-

Curriculum and Specializations

The curriculum for distance MBA courses at NMIMS vs Symbiosis is slightly different and is mainly specialization-oriented. Every course has a few compulsory core courses followed by industry-specific electives. Every specialization has its own set of electives that can be opted for as per the student's preference.

The specialization available in NMIMS vs Symbiosis distance MBA programs is mentioned in the following table:

Career Opportunities

The career opportunities offered to distance MBA graduates remain the same for students, irrespective of the university they attended. NMIMS and Symbiosis are both globally recognized and UGC-entitled, which makes their distance MBA equally credible as a traditional MBA degree course and provides similar career opportunities to their graduates.

The average salary offered to Symbiosis and NMIMS distance MBA programs varies between INR 5 and INR 7 LPA, approximately, and the majorly offered job profiles are as follows:

  • Marketing Manager
  • HR Consultant
  • Data Scientist
  • Business Analyst
  • Store Manager, etc

Pros and Cons

There are both pros and cons of NMIMS and Symbiosis distance MBA programs, such as:

NMIMS vs Symbiosis Distance MBA Pros and Cons

Comparison TypeNMIMS Distance MBASymbiosis Distance MBA
ProsExtensive placement services. Includes live online interactive lectures. 500+ hiring partners and personalized career services.Extremely high global acceptance. Highly cost-effective fee structure. Availability of 15+ domain-centric specializations. AICTE-approved programs with flexible learning.
ConsComparatively higher course fee than Symbiosis. Quite a few global recognitions and accreditations.Less live interaction with faculty. Offers postgraduate diploma courses rather than a direct MBA degree.

Conclusion

Pursuing higher education has become a need for career growth and increasing earning potential. Simultaneously, NMIMS and Symbiosis are both decent choices for distance MBA programs. Students are advised to analyze their needs and requirements before choosing between NMIMS and Symbiosis and go after the institution that perfectly aligns with their career objectives.

FAQs

  • Can I pursue NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA while working full-time?
  • Yes, you can pursue an NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA while working full-time.
  • Which university offers better flexibility in exam schedules?
  • NMIMS offers better flexibility in exam schedules.
  • Are there any hidden charges in NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA fees?
  • NMIMS does not include admission processing fee, exam fee, and some other miscellaneous fees in the overall course fee as compared to Symbiosis SCDL.
  • Can international students apply for the NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA?
  • Yes, international students can apply for the NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA if they fulfill the admission criteria.
  • Which program has better online learning resources?
  • NMIMS distance MBA provides better online learning resources.
  • Is there an age limit for applying to NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA?
  • There is no upper age limit for candidates applying to NMIMS or Symbiosis distance MBA.
